correctness.rationale: Distinct monic integral cyclotomic factors contribute their totients independently. The 2-power layer has all subset sums 0 through M; each p-layer is its scalar multiple. A lower-digit block through j-1 has maximum Mp^(j-1), so translated intervals join in the complete case and the higher digit strictly dominates in the sparse case. Carrying at position j then gives the claimed difference, with M choices for the changed digit and (M+1)^(b-j) choices above it. The omitted-degree count uses both endpoints 0 and N. Uniform distinct degrees correspond bijectively to uniform tuples. Reverse the higher digits and couple to the infinite digit sequence: the u0 term and omitted tail both lie in [0,p^(-b)], so the error is at most p^(-b). The separated level-k cylinders have length p^(-k) and mass (M+1)^(-k); the uniform packing bound gives the lower Hausdorff dimension, the cover gives the upper dimension and zero Lebesgue measure, and the vanishing cylinder mass excludes atoms. In the stated odd-prime range p-1-M is a positive even integer, so the aside about merging a size-one carry gap is unnecessary and no admissible case is affected.
residual_risks: The 77 finite enumerations are recorded corroboration, not reviewer execution or proof of the limit.

originality.rationale: The complete-regime threshold is a known specialization. A distinct indexed finding on precisely the sparse family supplies the same distinct digit parametrization, count, nonunit gap multiset and Cantor support/dimension, in addition to actual divisor fibers. Its divisor-weighted weak limit is not the uniform-distinct-degree law. The latter, however, follows directly from its explicit one-to-one full digit cube by uniform choice and digit truncation; it is not a distinct substantive result beyond the verified coverage. This is a comparison of scientific content, not a finding that the Nov. 1 indexed record preceded the frozen Oct. 26 record or a claim of copying.
residual_risks: Index dates and source identifiers do not establish publication or discovery priority.
Bounded literature search does not exclude older equivalent results. The weighted and uniform laws are genuinely different measures.
